naturally_trimmed.config.enable_features: Enables the Loot Table trimming feature
Enables the Villager Trade Trimming feature
naturally_trimmed.config.trimMobs.desc: Settings for trimming a mobs equipment
naturally_trimmed.config.trimMobs.noTrim: Chance of the mob having no trims at all
naturally_trimmed.config.trimMobs.trimCh: Chance of each equipment piece having a trim applied. Applies individually to each armor piece
Settings for trimming items generated by loot tables
Chance of an item generated by a loot table of having a trim applied
naturally_trimmed.config.trimTrades.trim: Chance of an item from a villager trade having a trim applied
naturally_trimmed.config.trimTrades.minL: The minimum villager trading level an item needs to be in, to be considered of being trimmed
naturally_trimmed.config.filtering.desc: Settings for filtering which trims can be used by the mod
naturally_trimmed.config.filtering.textu:
Enables filtering trims by checking for the corresponding textures of the trim.

However, this only works on the client, it will be not be applied on dedicated servers, due to textures not being available on dedicated servers.

See 'https://github.com/Imajo24I/Naturally-Trimmed/wiki/Config-%E2%80%90-3.5.0#texture-validation-filtering'

When this setting *is* applied (on client + enabled), it will override some built-in filtering (none of the other trim filtering config entries!).
naturally_trimmed.config.filtering.vanil: Use only vanilla trim materials and patterns
naturally_trimmed.config.filtering.trimF: Opens the config file inside the standard text editor. This option is not viewable via the config screen.
naturally_trimmed.config.utils.desc: Utility buttons to make configuring the mod easier
Opens the config file inside the standard text editor
naturally_trimmed.config.utils.reloadCon:
Reload the config from the config file.
Useful for exampel for configuring the trimFilter config entry, since it is only configurable through the config file
naturally_trimmed.config.utils.validateT:
Validates the trim filter and logs relevant information in chat.
Only works while inside a world. Log messages may be cut off in the minecraft chat due to length limits, check the log file
naturally_trimmed.config.backup_screen.i: Install Yet Another Config Lib to access the config screen
